mapper.select: select (doc->'lsite'->'pub')::text pub, coalesce(doc->'ledger'->>'on', doc->'org'->>'ledger_on') = 'true' as led, case when doc->>'lpxSeq' ~ '^[0-9]{1,15}$' then (doc->>'lpxSeq')::bigint else 0 end seq from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}

select (doc->'lsite'->'pub'->'comm')::text comm, doc->'org'->>'type' type, case when doc->>'lpxSeq' ~ '^[0-9]{1,15}$' then (doc->>'lpxSeq')::bigint else 0 end seq, (select m from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(doc->'members') = 'array' then doc->'members' else '[]'::jsonb end) m where m->>'sid' = #{sid} or m->>'id' = #{sid} limit 1)::text m from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}

select (data->'_cm')::text cm from learner_events where tenant_id = #{tid} and id > #{seq} and type in ('post-new', 'post-cmt') and data->'_cm' is not null and at > now() - interval '30 days' order by id limit 300
select (doc->'lsite'->'pub'->'hp'->'seo')::text seo, doc->'lsite'->'pub'->'hp'->>'name' name, (doc->'lsite'->'pub'->'org')::text org from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select sid, dept, code_hash, pw_hash from learners where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
select dept, pw_hash from learners where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
mapper.update: update learners set last_login = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
mapper.select: select lp::text lp from learner_progress where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
select doc::text doc from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select kind, login, nickname, student_no, dept, status, minor, idv_ok from learner_accounts where tenant_id = #{tid} and learner_id = cast(#{sid} as uuid)
mapper.insert: insert into learner_progress (tenant_id, sid, lp, bytes) values (#{tid}, #{sid}, cast(#{lp} as jsonb), #{bytes}) on conflict (tenant_id, sid) do update set lp = excluded.lp, bytes = excluded.bytes, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: insert into ai_usage (tenant_id, day, calls) values (#{tid}, cast(#{day} as date), 1) on conflict (tenant_id, day) do update set calls = ai_usage.calls + 1 returning calls
mapper.update: update ai_usage set tin = tin + #{tin}, tout = tout + #{tout} where tenant_id = #{tid} and day = cast(#{day} as date)
mapper.insert: insert into learner_sessions (id, tenant_id, sid, expires_at) values (#{id}, #{tid}, #{sid}, now() + interval '30 days')
mapper.select: select tenant_id, sid, extract(epoch from now() - last_at)::float8 idle from learner_sessions where id = #{id} and expires_at > now()
select doc->'org'->'cpl'->>'idleH' from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid} and (doc->'org'->'cpl'->>'on')::boolean
mapper.update: update learner_sessions set last_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, sid, type, xid, data::text data, to_char(at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') at from learner_events where tenant_id = #{tid} and id > #{after} order by id limit 200
select (doc->'coupons')::text cp, (doc->'lsite'->'pub'->'classes')::text cl, (doc->'lsite'->'pub'->'pay')::text pay from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select count(*)::int from learner_events where tenant_id = #{tid} and type = 'pay' and upper(data->>'cpn') = #{code}
insert into learner_events (tenant_id, sid, type, xid, data) values (#{tid}, #{sid}, #{type}, #{xid}, #{data}::jsonb) returning id
select count(*) from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
mapper.delete: delete from learner_events where tenant_id = #{tid} and at < now() - interval '90 days'
mapper.select: select consent::text consent, true has from learners where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid}
mapper.update: update learners set consent = #{v}::jsonb where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and consent is null
